title: Ombudsman’s ‘ghost internet’ probe zeroes in on DICT

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman said their fact-finding probe on the so-called “ghost internet” in the government free WiFi program will center around the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT). DICT, for its part, said it welcomes the anti-graft body’s inquiry, noting that it maintains a policy of zero tolerance against corruption. “We have uncovered a scheme that we are calling ‘ghost internet’,” said Assistant Ombudsman Mico Clavano in a press conference on Friday. “The investigation will center around the DICT.” READ: DICT: No current gov’t data compromised amid hacking reports “When you ask people who were […]...
